name: Eric Milam
biography: (@Brav0Hax) is a principal security assessor on the Accuvant LABS enterprise assessment team with over fifteen (15) years of experience in information technology. Eric has performed innumerable consultative engagements including enterprise security and risk assessments, perimeter penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, social engineering, physical security testing, wireless assessments and extensive experience in PCI compliance controls and assessments. Eric is a project steward for the Ettercap project as well as creator and developer of the easy-creds and smbexec projects. IRC > J0hnnyBrav0
